correctness.rationale: For each finite t outside 0,1,3 the initiating paper guarantees a smooth genus-two curve. The exact identity P(x,t)=F_t(x(x−1)) constructs commuting elliptic involutions; both invariant function fields are explicit genus-one hyperelliptic models. Their degree-two separable quotient maps induce an isogeny E+×E−→Jac(C). The two cubic/quartic Hasse coefficient polynomials factor as (t²+2)(t²−2t−2) and (t−2)(t+1)(t²+2). Exhaustive symbolic F5[t,z] operations in standalone verify.py establish these identities and show all exceptional factors simple, pairwise disjoint as asserted, and disjoint from singular fibers. Isogeny invariance of p-rank gives rank 0 at the two common roots, rank 1 at four other roots, and rank 2 elsewhere; both supersingular elliptic factors imply supersingular Jacobian at the common roots. No numerical sample substitutes for a universal proof. A separate exact computation of the genus-two Cartier–Manin matrix [[c4,c3],[c9,c8]] for coefficients of P(x,t)^2 gives diagonal H−,H+ and upper right −2t(t²+2), lower left 0. Therefore its rank is 0 at the common Hasse roots, 1 at the four other exceptional roots, and 2 elsewhere. Since a=2−rank, the pairs (p-rank,a-number) are (0,2), (1,1), (2,0), and a=2 proves the two genus-two Jacobians superspecial. The standalone standard-library script verifies each matrix entry as a universal polynomial identity.

value.rationale: The input fibration attains the extremal four-singular-fiber bound for semistable genus-two fibrations in characteristic five. The exact smooth-fiber Newton/p-rank stratification is a motivated arithmetic-geometric invariant of this special family, not a gratuitous specialization. It determines the two supersingular and four almost-ordinary fibers exactly, while exhibiting natural elliptic quotients that can support further arithmetic and degeneration study. The general quotient mechanism is standard but this finite exception classification is neither a textbook deduction without computation nor a recomputation of a checked known table. Determining superspeciality rather than merely supersingularity supplies the sharpest a-number boundary for genus-two Jacobians and strengthens the finite classification without changing the natural source object.
